project_type.name: Full DSL Reference Template
project_type.description: A comprehensive starter template that exercises every supported DSL element: parameters, human and agent roles, project/workflow/node-scoped artifacts, all node kinds, and explicit outcome-based edges.

parameters.description: Display name for projects created from this template.
Expected user-count scale used to guide planning depth.
Whether final approval must include an explicit human sign-off.
Structured research context supplied at project creation time.
The primary delivery channels that should shape the output.

roles.description: The human owner who provides source context, gives feedback, and approves deliverables.
roles.default_prompt: You are the accountable owner. Provide clear business context, judge quality rigorously, and only approve work that is ready to execute.

roles.description: Agent responsible for turning source context into structured product requirements.
roles.default_prompt: You are a senior product manager. Produce complete, concrete, and implementation-ready product requirements.

roles.description: Agent responsible for turning approved requirements into visual planning artifacts.
roles.default_prompt: You are a senior product designer. Produce clear low-fidelity visual deliverables that match the approved requirements.

artifacts.description: Initial project brief shared across the entire project type.
Reference image that captures visual direction for the project.

workflow_types.description: Capture a brief, draft and revise a PRD, approve it, and produce a wireframe deliverable.

nodes.title: Provide Brief
nodes.description: Capture the initial brief and supporting context for the project.
nodes.prompt: Provide the problem statement, user context, constraints, success criteria, and any visual references needed to start planning.

nodes.title: Draft PRD
nodes.description: Produce the first PRD draft from the brief and brand guidance.
nodes.prompt: Turn the available context into a structured PRD with clear scope, requirements, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.

nodes.title: Collect Feedback
nodes.description: Gather human commentary on the drafted PRD before formal approval.
nodes.prompt: Review the draft PRD and provide specific revision guidance, missing constraints, and risks that should be addressed.

nodes.title: Revise PRD
nodes.description: Revise the PRD based on the internal feedback context from upstream review or feedback.
nodes.prompt: Update the PRD to resolve all provided human guidance while keeping the document consistent and executable.

nodes.title: Approve PRD
nodes.description: Approve the PRD or route it back for another revision cycle.
nodes.prompt: Approve only when the PRD is ready to guide downstream execution; otherwise request revision with concrete direction.

nodes.title: Create Wireframe
nodes.description: Produce visual planning assets from the approved PRD.
nodes.prompt: Create a low-fidelity wireframe aligned with the approved PRD and visual direction.

artifacts.description: Node-scoped rationale describing the wireframe decisions.
Node-scoped preview image local to the wireframe node.
